name: sd-review-local-rebuttal-gap
title: sd-review cannot record a rebutted local finding
description: Local provider findings enter the receipt as disposition outstanding and there is no coordinator control that moves one to rebutted. --remote-disposition accepts only remote stable ids, and the family-evidence route requires localOutcome clean, so it cannot dispose of the finding that made the outcome non-clean. A verifiably wrong local finding therefore blocks the remote gate until code changes. Decide between documenting the constraint locally and proposing an upstream local-disposition control.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Observed on PR #158 (2026-08-06): two verifiably wrong prism findings blocked the sd-ship chain at Stage 2 with no control able to record the rebuttal. Deliberately excluded from 08-06-prism-rules-lane-divergence's scope, since folding it in would have let that task's own findings be waved through. All three surfaces are installed from the sd-ai-command-pack (.sd-ai-command-pack/manifest.json), provenance-tracked and undrifted, so adding a control is upstream work; only this repository's spec guidance is editable locally. Fifth instance of the vendored-artifact pattern, which now warrants a task of its own. Sequencing: eight active tasks edit .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md. `order` 40 within the P2 band encodes the intended landing sequence (what a run does with a wrong finding; downstream of the lane fix). Tasks with no `order` sort as 0 and therefore run before this cluster, which is intended: they do not contend for this file.
